providers.title: Entropy does not depend on the metric
providers.scope: Compatible metrics on a compact space give the same topological entropy.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Invariant pieces
providers.scope: A restriction has at most the entropy of the map; a union of two compact invariant sets has the larger of their entropies; periodic maps have entropy zero.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Entropy localization (OpenAI)
providers.scope: If every orbit approaches a compact forward invariant set Z with h(F|Z) = 0, then h(F) = 0; no uniform time of approach is needed.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Radial register maps have zero entropy (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Products of sphere maps that send the sphere into a disc and move radii by a nondecreasing map have zero entropy.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The clock barrier
providers.scope: A smooth 100-periodic b with values in [0,1], vanishing only at 50, equal to one away from it, with t + b(t) <= 50 on [0,50].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The map is C^1 (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The prediction inputs are C^1 with |U| < 1/5, and the clock-register map f is a C^1 self-map of M.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Attraction (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Every orbit tends to Z_0 (clock at 50, main coordinate 0) or to Z_inf (main coordinate infinite, registers zero).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Bounded clocks
providers.scope: A bounded lifted clock converges to 50 modulo 100, and then the main coordinate tends to 0.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Preparation
providers.scope: In a complete passage the registers are zero at the first preparation step, there are one to four preparation steps, a full readout occurs, and |z| > 1/2 at preparation.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Clock prediction (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Each readout window is met at most once per passage, and the predictions meet it exactly at the actual readout step.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Registers are linear until read (OpenAI)
providers.scope: At its readout a register has modulus at most 1/2 and equals the explicit sum of its prepared phases.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Escape in one passage (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Readouts are in phase with z^2, so |z'| >= |z|^2 through the passage, and some step has |z| > 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Zero entropy (OpenAI)
providers.scope: f has zero topological entropy, and so do its restrictions to Z_0 and Z_inf.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A sphere on which f squares
providers.scope: f(0, z, 0, ..., 0) = (1, z^2, 0, ..., 0), so f composed with i is homotopic to i composed with squaring.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Squaring has degree two
providers.scope: z -> z^2 multiplies the fundamental class of the Riemann sphere by 2, with real coefficients.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The eigenvector (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The class of the sphere i(Sigma) is nonzero in H_2(M; R), and f_* multiplies it by 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A C^1 counterexample to the entropy conjecture (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A C^1 self-map of a compact manifold of dimension 2q+3 >= 7, neither injective nor surjective, with zero entropy and the eigenvalue 2 on H_2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
